title: The Symbolism of Gold, Greenness, and Snow
english: In the middle of it, for if indeed your mercy is released to you, according to Jeremiah, 'I have abandoned my concern, I have left my inheritance' (Jer 31:9), as he passes through the desert in the church of the nations, the earth was shaken—that is, the letter and the shadow of the law—because it was not called thick. And the earthquake of this happened, the divine dew having poured down from the heavens according to the life-giving spirit of the divine writings. And the heavens shall be spoken of in these things, namely Moses and the prophets, or the mystical theorems; and heaven and clouds mean the same thing for this. Oh, indeed the heavens poured, but elsewhere the clouds rained down righteousness (Ps 67:10-11). But also for the nations having been transferred from idolatry, the earth was shaken, while the spiritual dew-drops of the apostles, evangelists, and the rest of the teachers of the evangelical dispensation were remaining.

The spoken rain, having received the life-giving [spirit] of the Lord through weakness and desiring the cross, perfected the flesh, living by the power of God. For the divine Word gave life to his own body, having been crucified through weakness. And indeed the believer, a poor people from among the nations, is able to be, because God is, and without false hope. Concerning him the prophecy of Isaiah says: 'For this reason the poor people shall bless you, and cities of unjust men shall bless you' (Isa 61:1); for those being oppressed by Satan were acting unjustly.

'Other' signifies the lots and the conductors of the waters. For it is said in Genesis concerning Issachar, that having been called a farmer man, he rested among the lots (Gen 49:14); so one must now turn toward the old and the new covenant. For these indeed provide a watering for the intellect for spiritual fruitfulness. One sleeps among these two lots, placing them together in the midst of one God, as a way to distinguish the spirit from the letter. One having slept thus between the lots flies, perceiving according to the Holy Spirit. And since you will not perceive the wings of this dove as lifting up the winged soul, it is testified by the divine sayings that there exists refined silver; they are being purified, those who are transferred, joined to the greenness of the dove with the gold. Often of the divine...
Gold is taken for the sharpness of the mind. Greenness signifies the life of the gold; for this color is a symbol of living plants.

Regarding the 'among the lots' and 'thus' in Leviticus: on the day of atonement, two goats were brought to the tent of meeting; one was cast into the lot to be sacrificed to the Lord upon the altar, the other being sent away to the wilderness for the one who sends it. These are symbols of good and evil; he who is in the midst must discern them, to perform the good to the Lord and to send away the evil to the one who appeases, since from it he received the beginning. Thus one will fashion the spread wings and the greenness of gold in the translations.

And the knowledge of divine scripture shines out like gold (Ps 67:14c). 'They shall be covered with snow in Selom,' meaning they shall be filled with snows (Ps 67:15). These are the virtues, watering the mind with springs and cooling the flame of the passions. For 'Wash me, and I shall be white as snow' (Ps 51:7) is not about physical snow. For it is an ineffable thing toward the brightness of a purified soul. Such also is 'If your sins are as scarlet, I will make them white as snow' (Isa 1:18) and 'The Nazarenes were cleansed of it through snow' (Ps 67:15).

Solomon is interpreted as a shadow of a portion. Therefore, since the kings (not the apostles) who once kept the law according to the shadow are a portion of shadows, having indeed a spiritual portion but having also been tested by the shadow. Such is the one saying 'I am a Hebrew of Hebrews, a Pharisee according to the law.' And since the portion of Christ's disciples in the heavens is according to 'He has made us sufficient for the portion of the saints in light' (Col 1:12), but we have not yet reached it, as if the citizenship were in the heavens while walking upon earth, knowing in part and prophesying in part and having the earnest of the Spirit, they are in the shadow of their own portion. Therefore, it is a great thing that a life experiencing this finds itself being covered with snow unstained.
'The cloud of the Lord the Savior exists'; for it is said concerning him, 'The cloud of the Lord shall appear at the end of days' (Ps 68:1) and again 'Upon'...
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: The Ascent through Sinai and the Nature of Blessing
english: The high mountain ascends, the one being evangelized to Zion. And this ascent is through progress. Therefore, the God who is the Word, Wisdom, Life, and Sanctification, is nourishing, not receiving potency from without, but providing it to those who partake of Him. This mountain is both nourishing and matured, giving milk to some and imparting solid food to others, and nothing other than this besides milk; for it has become a food that is solid. It will be spoken of as being matured, and thus: the nourishing mountain, God, became man, having taken flesh from a virgin, through whom He is called matured, the human generation being made manifest by this expression, just as it is clearly said in Job to God, 'Remember that you formed me from clay' (Job 10:9), and furthermore: 'Did you not milk me as with milk and knead me with curds?' (Job 10:10), and 'You clothed me with skin and flesh' (Job 10:11). Since the matured one preserves the divinity harmlessly, and continues to nourish after being matured, the very words establish it, saying: a matured mountain, a nourishing mountain. For it is nourishing both before and after being matured. If you suppose the mountain is matured, did God not delight in it? (Ps 67:17). The argument fits better against the Valentinians. For the Savior is called by many names in the Scripture, and according to each, a different essence is shown, such as calling the Lord apart from Jesus and Wisdom, and the others. Now the mountain is that in which the Lord dwells, according to 'what God was in Christ' and 'the Father who abides in me'. Therefore, demand the reason by which you supposed many mountains to be matured, but rather the one incarnate is a single matured mountain, in whom the Lord, having been born of the Theotokos virgin, dwells permanently without moving from one to another as He did with the holy men; but teachers became men—Moses and the prophets and the apostles—and even angels. For if the word spoken through angels became firm, how much more was the one being nourished as if being struck from God and being matured? Do not think such things are many by nature, like polytheism. The army of God is not single, but is myriads.
The army of God is not single but is myriads.

The voices of the choir of the saints are yoked together with him: Moses and the prophets, the apostles, the evangelists, the angels, the archangels, the principalities, the powers, the dominions, and those simply receiving God and having the Holy Spirit, who in the psalm says, 'Ride upon the horses, O Lord, and thy chariot is salvation' (Ps 68:14). For through them the saving gospel was stretched out into the inhabited world. For more ranks appear yoked to the yoke of Christ. For this reason it has approached like an army of tens of thousands making straight their path, for no one among them is without fruit.

Just as an army and a chariot compose the unit in those whom God holds, so also the hosts having come to Sinai have the Lord within themselves, the lawgiver. And this is a high thing, in which God, having descended, commands Moses to ascend. For it is impossible for a created thing to ascend to divine height, unless God first descends with it. And Sinai is interpreted as temptation, not synonymous with a storm, but a trial, through which one, being tested by much experience, will be high, as the lawgiver ascending upon it and being revealed as a hierophant by the favor of God.

These preceding voices from the choir of the saints are spoken to the one ascending through the cross to the height, and there having taken captive those who are being tyrannized by Satan and freeing them from his bitterness, his tyranny, having given a ransom for his soul instead of many (Ps 68:18). In this way he redeemed all. For since not all come to him willingly and of their own accord, he takes even those who disobey to dwell with him. For many, disobeying the call of the gospel, are drawn away by sickness and other distraction. And some even came through visions to dwell with Jesus.

Of so many benefits occurring from the Lord, how could I not intend to bless the cause of such great blessings, and to bless—not perhaps never, nor perhaps always—but mixing prayer with blessing every day, asking that they may be guided by God, who grants the desire for salvation? And he is blessed, not by receiving blessing, but by giving these. For as a man is good, not by becoming so but by doing good things.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: The Ways of Death and Life
english: And a holy one sanctifies, not is being sanctified. Therefore also he is blessed, the fountain of all blessing to us (Ps 67:21-22). If the preceding things are said concerning common death, there are myriad ways known to all toward the common death; but if concerning living according to God and the death opposing this is also signified here, our God, the Savior, is the God of saving. For he becomes the cause of eternal salvation. Indeed he says concerning himself, 'The Savior does not stand away from me.' Just as God is of saving, so also the exits of death do not possess him as lord, providing always exits through which one comes out through repentance from the death following sin. For also the devil is not so named in 'Death prevailed, having been strong.' But he provides the exits of death to the one lifted up from the gates of death (1 Chron 4:10). And the heads are the enemies, or the rulers, or the dominating things, as in 'From the heads of the rulers of nations'; and the dominating thing in 'I gave their paths into their heads' (Ps 74:6), and 'Your hands are upon my head' (Ps 139:10). Both perhaps are shown by 'You cast death into the heads of the lawless' (Ps 140:9), the God doing good so that they might not live wickedly, being described as the life according to sin. But these enemies, being such, wander in their transgressions.

It should be noted also what the divine scripture sets as the name of the vision concerning Moses. For the ways of God are not grasped, but are pious and with right understanding (Ps 67:26). Let us say 'those singing who accomplish the practical life,' and let us omit the young women playing the timbrel, having deadened the members upon the earth and carrying the death of Jesus in their bodies, souls wandering. These singers were overtaken by the rulers according to teaching, so that they themselves might begin from practical virtue. But they are also in the midst of young women, those who because of having the beginning of playing the timbrel—that is, deadening the members upon the earth of the young women spoken of—are the rulers overtaking the singers, which are the apostles. The springs of Israel are the legal and prophetic writings. For from these springs the Lord is blessed toward those able to draw from them the spring of salvation (Ps 67:27).
Ps 67:27: The springs of Israel are the legal and prophetic writings.
For from these springs the Lord is blessed by those able to draw from them, since they are saving springs, water with gladness.
And this is concerning what Jesus said: 'Whoever drinks of the water that I shall give him shall have in himself a spring of water welling up unto eternal life' (John 4:14).

And by this those who sever the old Scripture from the new are to be refuted, as though they cannot bless God in the churches, not having the springs of Israel nor their Lord—as if daring to divide the Godhead itself.
Ps 67:29-30: 'Command with your power over all things, O Creator, that having sojourned it may loose the weakness of men.'
And coming to us from your temple, it shall loose it, with what was wrought for our sake having been strengthened.
And this is the birth of Emmanuel, by your Word becoming flesh.
To this power, which is God the Word, God said that all things should come to be, and he commanded that diverse things be created.
With the weakness loosed by the presence of God's power, the kings bring gifts to God to the spiritual Jerusalem, that is, the church.
And if those kings whom the heavenly one distinguished in his inheritance are those bearing the gifts to Jerusalem, those benefited by them are the ones being led forward.
Thus the apostle Peter offered as a gift his brother Andrew, and Philip offered Nathanael, and the other apostles many others,
and others offered as gifts serious thoughts and words and praiseworthy works.

And Nathanael, and all their own disciples; that is, the faithful, according to 'And would that you did reign, that we also might reign with you' (1 Cor 4:8), whose gifts are thoughts and words and praiseworthy works.
Ps 67:31a: Understand as 'beasts of the reed' those who advocate the falsely-named knowledge (1 Tim 6:20).
The prophecy which runs thus can be said concerning these: 'Woe to those who write wickedness; for writing wickedness, they write.'
Ps 67:32: By Egypt he signified the whole earth, over which the intelligible Pharaoh ruled,
and by Ethiopia the dark and unsightly state of the souls in sins;
as he also says in one of the psalms: 'And behold, aliens and Tyre and the people of the Ethiopians; these were born there' (Ps 86:4)—clearly, in the spiritual Zion.
And Zephaniah also says: 'Then he will turn toward [...].'
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
